action.description: list = the org's whole taxonomy catalog (one compact line of shape per field); get = one field in full, including its extraction prompt, scoring rubrics and payload keys.

fieldId.description: Required for action "get" — the field id from `list`, e.g. "objection.raised".

aopId.description: Optional: restrict to one org playbook (AOP) when the org runs more than one taxonomy set. Omit for all of them — most orgs have exactly one.

user_request_summary.description: One sentence, in your own words: what the user actually asked you to do in this turn. Used only for Cedar's observability — it does not change what this tool does.

is_new_request.description: true on the FIRST Cedar tool call of a NEW user request; false when this call continues the same request you are already working on. Groups related calls into one activity thread.
